reference: Three large carpet patches, averaged. The carpet dominates the frame and is the surface objects are judged against.
why: calibration/color_profile.json did not exist, so load_gains() returned ones and correct_bgr was an identity LUT -- the colour pipeline was wired up and doing nothing. Measured 2026-09-24: carpet read R/G 1.147, B/G 1.139 and the planner refused a target saying "visible red object is the white cube under pink lighting". The far wall reads a much stronger cast (R/G 1.41) than the near carpet, so the illuminant is not uniform and no single gain fixes both; correcting on the wall turned the carpet green. Re-measure if the room lighting changes.
